Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + evidence intake (initial)

Hi Monica —

We're kicking off our vendor assurance intake for Q2. Could you please confirm whether Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report that covers a 2027 audit period and share the standard artifacts you can provide (report PDF, bridge letter, and an evidence manifest)? Our procurement and security teams will need the audit window to map to our control baseline — ideally we need confirmation of the start/end dates of the covered period.

We typically ask for:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter or equivalent statement if the report coverage doesn't map exactly to our requested window
- Evidence manifest or sample artifacts (policy snapshots, log samples, retention artifacts, change control evidence)
- A short list of who to contact for a live dry-run intake session (we usually run a 30-min dry-run to validate formats)

Can you also indicate secure transfer options (S3 presigned, SFTP, secure Drive) and whether you accept an NDAs-only approach or need a formal DPA amendment?

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Information Security Analyst
Arcadia Health

Lena — thanks for the clear list. Happy to take this on. Quick answers up front:

- Coverage: Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31 (testing period). I can share the report PDF and a bridge letter if you need mapping to a different internal window.
- What we can provide immediately: SOC2-2027-TypeII.pdf (redacted where appropriate), bridge-letter-template.docx, and an evidence manifest (CSV) showing sample artifacts and locations.
- Transfer options: we support S3 presigned URLs (preferred for bulk artifacts), secure SFTP to a temporary bucket, or a locked Google Drive folder with restricted viewer access. All transfers are logged.
- DPA/NDAs: our standard DPA covers this sharing; if you require an amended DPA or specific contract clause, loop in procurement and we can expedite.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll attach a short intake packet (SOC summary, proposed bridge language, evidence manifest).
2) Schedule a 30-minute dry-run intake with your security ops and our compliance engineer — I'm free Thu Apr 20 at 10:00 AM PT or 1:00 PM PT.
3) Share a preferred transfer method and I'll provision access and upload the sample artifacts.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (stub), bridge-letter-template.docx (stub), evidence-manifest.csv (stub)

One-line replies for your team if helpful: 
- "Confirm 2027-01-01 — 2027-12-31 coverage; we will share report + manifest via presigned S3."
- "We can run a 30-min dry-run on Thu Apr 20 at 10am PT; please send calendar invite."

If you'd like, I can also include a short mapping table that calls out common artifact names we provide (e.g., retention policy snapshot -> retention_policy_v2.pdf).

Best,
Monica Patel

Redwood Inference
